verdict.rationale: Otter ships a built-in assistant, Otter AI Chat. It answers questions across meetings and connected apps, can query the user's CRM, and helps create follow-ups, reports and content, so users can delegate drafting and research tasks to it. The evidence covers only content generation and Q&A. Nothing shows the assistant taking actions on the user's behalf, such as sending emails, creating tickets or updating records from a chat request. The automatic action-item syncs are separate automations, not tasks delegated to the assistant, so they are not credited. missing for 10: evidence that AI Chat can execute multi-step or action-taking tasks (sending, updating, creating items in other tools) on request, depth documentation of the assistant's delegable task types, and independent or hands-on corroboration of AI Chat.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Otter AI Chat searches across your meetings and connected apps to instantly answer questions and help you create follow-ups, reports, and content.
allow you to query your CRM directly through Otter AI Chat for more personalized responses
